experiment: noclaim_final_v1: claim module ablation — variant D (whole answer as ONE NLI hypothesis, no claim decomposition) vs A_typed, 3 dimensions (精度/定位/聚合语义)
variant_d_rule: qa_module.decompose_claims → [AnswerClaim(kind='semantic', text=answer)]; 整条answer一条claim, 无typed/句子分解
isolation_note: L0/L1 experts use answer_structure.decompose_answer(unpatched); 消融隔离的是per-claim通道+claim级融合聚合粒度

A_typed.note: A_typed: strict ∀ over per-claim verdicts, refute claim的claim_text定位到断言级(平均claim长31.3字符 vs test46 answer平均254字符)

partial_inconsistency.definition: gold=refute 且 typed分解≥2条claim (answer含多条断言, 不一致至多为部分; typed分解=variant A的断言粒度)
partial_inconsistency.claim_channel_note: D的claim通道只有一条整answer claim, span覆盖全句(ratio≈1.0)或find失败, 断言级定位为0——聚合退化为单claim判定, 无法归因到具体断言
